scope: Order-group metrics distinguish absent storage from path inspection errors
change: load_order_groups now uses Path::try_exists and propagates inspection errors so Prometheus reports metrics_available=0 instead of an empty healthy store.

verification.command: standalone rustc --test probe for Path::exists vs Path::try_exists on a NUL-containing path
assertions: Path::exists returns false for a path inspection error

verification.detail: Rustc reported E0786/invalid metadata and only-metadata-stub errors while compiling qx-app/qx-data; Windows also reported page-file exhaustion during this session. The service tests did not run.
WSL returned Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/CreateVm/E_ABORT; the Podman VM remains stopped.

limitations: The service-level regression test was added but could not be compiled or executed in this environment; it still requires CI or Linux runner verification.
This improves fail-closed metrics reporting only; it does not establish exchange connectivity or update connector maturity.
